## About
Gino's Auto Repair is a family owned and operated shop on Monroe Road in Charlotte. Gino started the business here, and today Tony and the team keep it running with the same idea: handle every car with honesty and integrity.
We're trained and certified mechanics who keep up with the latest auto technology, so we can take care of everything from routine maintenance to bigger repairs on foreign and domestic vehicles.
Our customers give us a 4.8 rating from 169 Google reviews. Bring your car by or give us a call and tell us what's going on.

## Services
- General repair and maintenance: Everyday upkeep and repairs to keep your car running right.
- Brakes: One reviewer came in to get their brakes serviced.
- Electrical and warning lights: A reviewer new to Charlotte needed an electrical and warning lights issue fixed.
- Heating and A/C repair: Repairs for your car's heating and air conditioning.
- Steering and suspension: Work on the parts that keep your ride smooth and your steering true.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. The shop handles major and minor repairs on both foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: You'll find us at 3917 Monroe Rd B in Charlotte, NC 28205.
